Actually "海平面下5000米處" means 5000 meters below sea level, i.e., at depth 5000 m. They want boiling point and melting point of water at that depth. We have a function get_boiling_melting_points that takes substance and sea_level. But sea_level parameter is in meters. It says "Retrieve the boiling point and melting point of a substance based on its name and the sea level." So we need to call the function with substance "water" and sea_level 5000? But sea_level is the sea level in meters. The function likely expects sea level altitude relative to sea level? Actually "sea_level" might be the altitude above sea level? But the description: "Retrieve the boiling point and melting point of a substance based on its name and the sea level." So sea_level is the altitude? But the user wants at 5000 meters below sea level. That is negative altitude: -5000 m. So we should pass sea_level = -5000. But the function expects number. So we call get_boiling_melting_points with substance "water" and sea_level -5000. Then we output the result.
